description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single ranged jump attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK and MND +30%, DEF and RES +25% (25s)]/[ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies if 0-4/4+ Type-0 allies are alive, grants [Attach Wind], [Awoken Wind], [Damage Cap +10000] and [Spear Torpedo] to the user

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Awoken Wind
description.text: Wind abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Spear Torpedo
description.text: Grants [Wind Ability +50% Boost 1] to the user after using two Wind abilities
